P1.2.text: Proficient Auto Logistics is a leading freight company backed by the industry’s best auto transport and logistics providers. Call us today to learn more.

P1.3.text: Powering Auto Transport Across North America

P1.4.text: Proficient Auto Logistics is a leading freight company backed by the industry’s best auto transport and logistics providers. With one of the largest fleets in North America, we specialize in moving finished vehicles from production plants, ports, and rail hubs to a national network of dealerships.

P1.6.text: Proficient Auto Logistics is built to serve the nation’s automotive supply chain at scale. Powered by multiple established operating companies and a network of strategically located terminals, we provide dependable transport for the world’s leading automakers across the country’s most critical production, distribution, and retail markets.

P1.7.text: Our strength lies in integration—bringing together deep industry experience, broad geographic reach, and long-standing customer partnerships to move vehicles with consistency, safety, and efficiency.

P1.8.text: We offer a wide range of opportunities—from driving and logistics to terminal operations and corporate roles—all backed by long-term stability and a dynamic, forward-moving team.

P1.9.text: Our North American Network Can Handle It All

P1.10.text: At Proficient Auto Logistics, we offer a range of specialty services across our network to meet your unique needs. Whether it’s custom transport solutions, expedited shipping, or secure storage, with real-time tracking we can accommodate many vehicle transport and logistics requests.

P1.11.text: We Let the Numbers Do the Talking

P1.12.text: From nationwide coverage to industry-leading delivery performance, our metrics reflect the strength, scale, and precision of our logistics network.

P1.13.text: With logistics expertise at every level

P1.15.text: Placed to maximize reach and efficiency

P1.17.text: With additional outside capacity readily available

P1.18.text: Automotive OEMs Served for U.S. Transport

P1.19.text: Trusted by the world’s leading automakers

P1.20.text: Shaping the Future of Auto Logistics

P1.21.text: As a company, PAL unites nine established auto transport and logistics providers under one powerful brand.

P1.22.text: We invite investors, analysts, and partners to explore how PAL is shaping the future of auto logistics.

P1.23.text: A leader in finished vehicle transportation

P1.24.text: Proficient Auto Logistics offers a full spectrum of auto transportation and logistics services. From leading automotive manufacturers and electric vehicle producers to auto dealers, auctions, rental car companies, and leasing providers, we work with a range of global customers on transport into and across the U.S. and Canada.

P1.25.text: If you have a need, we have a solution. Explore our services and discover how we can meet the transportation demands of any size or scope.

P1.26.text: Stay informed with the latest announcements, acquisitions, and milestones from across the Proficient Auto Logistics network.

P1.27.text: Proficient Auto Logistics Provides update on Expected Operating and Financial Metrics for third Quarter of Fiscal 2024

P2.2.text: Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, Proficient Auto Logistics is a trusted national leader in finished vehicle transport. With an operating fleet of over

P2.3.text: Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, Proficient Auto Logistics is a trusted national leader in finished vehicle transport. With an operating fleet of over 1,350 trucks, we ship more than four million units annually across the U.S. and Canada – safely, efficiently, and with customer service standards at the forefront. We’re a key partner for 100% of global OEMs who serve the domestic market, including dealerships, auctions, fleet providers, and EV manufacturers.

P2.4.text: Driven by people and powered by innovation, we are the trusted leader in auto logistics, creating new horizons together.

P2.5.text: We deliver on expectations. Excellence is the driving force of everything we do.

P2.6.text: Safety is everyone’s responsibility. We protect people, cargo, and communities – and it’s the cornerstone of our reputation.

P1.1.text: Logistics Services and Freight Shipping | J.B. Hunt

P1.2.text: Our mode-neutral shipping solutions make moving freight easy. We're creating the most efficient transportation network in North America.

P1.3.text: Read our latest white paper: Structural Forces Reshaping the Freight Market

P1.4.text: Change the way you do business with the J.B. Hunt 360 °® platform. We're eliminating inefficiencies by creating one place for you to manage every step of the transportation process.

P1.6.text: Access to thousands of qualified carriers

P1.7.text: Take advantage of the cost-effective and sustainable solutions from North America’s leading intermodal provider.

P1.8.text: Move over-the-road shipments with flexibility and efficiency through our J.B. Hunt 360box® drop-and-hook solution.

P1.9.text: Receive access to nationwide reach, visibility into performance, streamline shipments and more with less-than-truckload (LTL).

P1.10.text: Get best-in-class safety, route planning and optimization capabilities for your dedicated fleet when you work with J.B. Hunt teams.

P1.11.text: We’ve got you covered from the first mile all the way through last-mile deliveries to homes and job sites.

P1.12.text: Get customized support, supply chain visibility and seamless transloading service with over-the-road and rail options available.

P1.13.text: Get a provider that creates a custom supply chain for your business and handles the day-to-day operations for you.

P1.14.text: Get the capacity you need for your over-the-road freight, supported by thousands of qualified third-party carriers.

P1.15.text: That's why we have a passionate pursuit of excellence and are always striving for more. We listen, innovate and invest in order to provide you with excellence. J.B. Hunt is driven for you.

P1.16.text: "Technology in the global transportation space to me means real-time visibility and the 360 platform does a very nice job of providing that for me."

P1.17.text: Director of Global Transportation and Trade Compliance at a global fishing company

P1.18.text: "J.B. Hunt takes the time up front to really get to know our business, our pain points and then customize a tailored solution to meet those."

P1.19.text: Chief Executive Officer for a wholesale hardware and industrial supplies distributor

P2.1.text: Our Company | Creating Transportation Efficiency | J.B. Hunt

P2.2.text: J.B. Hunt provides a variety of freight transportation services to customers throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

P2.3.text: We got our start with five trucks, seven trailers and Mr. Hunt’s vision to create something big. We’ve grown a lot but our legacy of innovation and impact lives on. Together, we’re working toward our vision to create the most efficient transportation network in North America.

P2.4.text: "To get where we’re gonna go, it takes all of us. I can’t do it, you can’t do it, but we can do that."

P2.5.text: Our vision is to create the most efficient transportation network in North America. This statement keeps us focused on the future and what we’re aspiring for as a company. It encourages us to not only innovate solutions that make our company better, but to find ways to improve the greater supply chain.

P2.6.text: After more than 60 years in transportation, we’ve found everything we do comes back to these core foundations:

P2.7.text: People you trust. Technology that empowers. Capacity to deliver.

P2.8.text: Investing in these areas fuels our growth as a company so we can continue to innovate and drive transportation forward.

P2.9.text: Whether you’re managing a small business or a global supply chain, we have the infrastructure and capacity to meet your business where it is today and work with you to build a supply chain that helps your business grow in the future.

P2.10.text: We strive to be good stewards of their investments and deliver compounding returns for them.
